newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ABSA SAYS GROWTH TO SLOW IN SECOND HALF.
newsitem.headline: ABSA SAYS GROWTH TO SLOW IN SECOND HALF.

text.p: Amalgamated Banks of South Africa Ltd reported better-than-expected first-half earnings on Monday but cautioned that results for the full year would not reflect same growth rate as in first six months.
The bank said credit demand was tapering off while the high money market shortage was likely to continue "for some time", exerting pressure on margins.
However, given a stable operating environment, the group said it expected earnings for the year to be substantially better than in the previous year.
The bank reported headline earnings per share of 101.0 cents in the six months to September 30 from 73.1 a year ago, beating analysts' consensus forecast of 94.6.
